g.title: The app code. index.tsx is /, about.tsx is /about and blog/[slug].tsx is a dynamic route. _app.tsx, _document.tsx and nested files that start with an underscore are skipped.
Runs once when the server starts. It initialises the router first, then calls buildClient(), so routes and client chunks are ready before the first request.

Bun.Glob scans src/pages once at startup. Each file becomes a URL pattern compiled to a regular expression with a capture group per [param], and match() returns the first route that fits along with its params.

Bundles client.tsx for the browser as ES modules with code splitting. A plugin supplies the virtual module unnexted:pages, a map from each page's file path to a literal import(), so every page becomes its own chunk in dist/. It runs at every server start.
The bundle Bun.build writes: client.tsx as ES modules plus one chunk per page, split by the literal import() calls in unnexted:pages.
